constant_policy: Poke defaults and validation bounds, direction tolerance, static-target multiplier, commander scan defaults, submerged cutoff and lock resend interval use named values at the top of their consuming native files. cost_review: Poke reuses the existing per-unit nearby-contact traversal and AssessCohort's existing force values. It adds no traversal or allocation. Commander snipe retains the source's per-interval O(E + U + S*C) work and temporary O(C) commander vector, where E is known enemies, U owned units, S eligible snipers and C visible/scouted commanders. No performance improvement is claimed. The compatibility fallback maintains its hull list through UnitAdded, scans O(T) watched Thugs/Maces once a second and reasserts one fire-state order per task change or ResendSeconds interval. It preserves the working-copy ownership behavior. The profile explicitly enables tracking before UnitAdded callbacks; inactive profiles retain no hull list. Tick reacquires units by ID and drops dead/handed-over units, releasing their saved task handles.
